key_insight: UltraX improves pre-training data quality at scale by converting text refinement into reliable programmatic edits, including deletion, modification, and insertion.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical pipeline for large-scale corpus cleaning/refinement that is more efficient and stable than purely rule-based or LLM-only approaches.
method: Adaptive prompt optimization generates high-quality refined texts from expert LLMs.
Line Alignment Mapping and Dynamic Context Replacement turn text pairs into structured edit supervision.
Low-confidence filtering, ratio-controlled sampling, and post-processing stabilize training and inference.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports highest average performance across corpora and equal or better results than baselines with fewer training tokens.
watch_item: The pipeline likely depends on careful prompt optimization and alignment quality, so noisy supervision or brittle execution could reduce gains at scale.
paper_title: UltraX: Refining Pre-Training Data at Scale with Adaptive Programmatic Editing
